interpretation: Research synthesis and suggested PGMaps design, not claims that all methods are currently implemented.

methods.title: Quantities multiplied by matched bid or estimate rates
methods.pgmaps_recommendation: Retain the evidence observation and the separately adopted project rate; never label an estimate as a final account.

methods.title: Machine and crew productivity
methods.pgmaps_recommendation: Use historical completed-work records to calibrate production. Preserve performance requirements and uncertainty.

methods.title: Haul cycles and material movement
methods.pgmaps_recommendation: Avoid double counting loading or return when a quoted rate already includes them. Fleet output must respect loader and placement limits.

methods.title: Whole-project scope and allowances
methods.pgmaps_recommendation: Use inclusion/exclusion/unknown states and explicit percentage bases. An appraisal adjustment is not a project-cost multiplier.

methods.title: Road-class and treatment comparisons
methods.pgmaps_recommendation: Use as a plausibility comparison. Keep missing-denominator Scion figures excluded; a source range is not a route confidence interval.

methods.title: Recurring maintenance and economic alternatives
methods.pgmaps_recommendation: Distinguish owner financial costs from wider economic benefits. Compare road extension against incremental forwarding over the timber volume served.
